title: Split-search solver
statement: For each natural number $C$, define a family of Boolean Turing machines indexed by $e\in\mathbb{N}$. At $e=0$, the loop host runs a split-search body built from the prefixed word of $C$ ones; at $e>0$, it runs a split-search body built from the catalog unary polynomial generator with parameters $e-1$ and $C$. In both cases the fuel machine is the bit-length machine, and the host is configured in find mode.
caveat: The payload gives the machine construction but not the operational semantics of the loop host or split-search body, so the result of the search cannot be specified exactly.
